name: Store
tagline: Your own online shop on your own server: products of any type, campaigns, vouchers and newsletters, reviews, buyer accounts, your own design, card, PayPal, bank transfer or cash on delivery, and pages search engines can index.
features: Products of any type with their own fields (ready-made for electronics, clothing, books, food and more), options, photos, stock, vendors and sale prices
Card payments with your own Stripe account, PayPal, bank transfer and cash on delivery: the money goes straight to you
Automatic discounts and free shipping from an amount or a number of items, shown in the cart before checkout
Campaigns, voucher codes, announcements and email newsletters with product cards to confirmed subscribers
Buyers need no account to order; with one they see their orders and write to you. Reviews, product comparison, sharing and QR codes
Your own logo, banner, colours and fonts; search engine texts with a score per product; Google Analytics, Google Ads or the Meta pixel after the buyer agrees
A team where each member can have several roles (products, marketing, support, shipping, maintenance) and an overview of their tasks; statistics per product
Maintenance mode, and your shop in any language: copy the labels, translate them and paste them back
audience: Makers, small brands and local shops who want to sell online without a monthly shop subscription.

STORE_MASTER_KEY.help: Encrypts the Stripe and PayPal secrets the shop owner enters (32 random bytes, base64). Made on first start and kept in the data volume; set it to manage it yourself. Changing it makes the saved secrets unreadable: enter them again.

env.name: APP_SETTING_MEMBERS_OPEN_SHOPS
env.help: true lets every member open a shop of their own. false: only administrators open one, and members shop like visitors.
